enchantments.tooltip: Reflex Save +2: This item gives a +2 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Power II: This item grants the wearer +20 maximum spell points. Favored Souls and Sorcerers gain double spell points from this item.
Rune Arm Imbue: Electrical I: Wearing this Rune Arm will imbue any weapon you wield, dealing 1d4 points of electrical damage per hit.
This Rune Arm is craftable and can be customized using recipes at standard crafting devices after disjuncting.
